svg.title: Qwen3.5-35B-A3B W4A8 single-chip SWE concurrency speed-throughput tradeoff
svg.desc: Only client concurrency changes within the single-chip W4A8 real-MTP2 series. Every point is one 900s closed-loop observation on one Ascend 910B3 chip at max-num-seqs 16.

g.text: Qwen3.5-35B-A3B W4A8 · single-chip SWE prefix reuse
TP1 · 1×910B3 · FULL_DECODE_ONLY · MNS16 · real MTP2 · W4A8 (int4 experts) / BF16 KV · 900s/point

g.text: W4A8 + real MTP2 · int4 experts · bf16 KV
P90 request decode speed · output tokens/s
The line connects all five measured client C levels (C1/C2/C4/C8/C16); it is not a fitted curve or a cross-setting Pareto envelope.

One server instance, one line; max-num-seqs 16 equals the C16 offered load, so C16 is the saturation seat count, not beyond-capacity. The explicitly set KV budget (32.55 GiB = 5.31 lanes at 262144 tokens) keeps prefix reuse alive through C16, so throughput keeps rising. A same-weight control arm (int4 experts, KV tightened to 18.85 GiB = 3.07 lanes) reproduces the C16 gap with the weight width held fixed: this is a configuration choice, not an int4-operator speedup.
